areas.flowsSummary:
Navigation is one root native stack (nav.tsx), headers hidden. It holds Welcome, MainTabs and about 75 pushed routes, so the tab bar is hidden on every non-tab screen. The initial route is MainTabs when signed in or when Welcome has been seen, otherwise Welcome.

TAB BAR (the same for all roles): Home · Saved · Post · Rentals · Profile. Chat is removed by the compile-time constant CHAT_ENABLED=false (src/lib/config.ts:271). It is the only feature flag in the app: no remote config, no env-gated screens. The flag hides only the Chat tab and the two 'Chat with owner' buttons. The ChatDetails route, the Firestore unread subscription and the chat push listener remain, and the push-permission prompt still hangs off that subscription.

ROLE / SHOP MODE: there is no toggle. account_type 'merchant' is chosen once, at email/phone sign-up on About ('Are you a merchant?'). For merchants the Rentals tab renders ShopHome with segments Today | Bookings | My rentals, and the Post tab is gated by merchant_approval_status ('Merchant approval required', 'Request review again'). Non-merchant owners (and in fact everyone signed in) reach the same shop home from Profile > 'Today and bookings' → ShopToday ('Your shop'). Customers can list without approval: a Post tab press pushes ListAddPhotos, the AI photo-first flow.

AUTH: Welcome (3-slide carousel + Google / Apple(iOS) / email + 'Browse without an account'). Email → 'Email me a code' or 'Use my password' → Verify. 'Use my phone number instead' → Phone → Verify. An existing account is signed in and goes through goAfterSignIn: back to the ProductDetail or SearchResults that prompted sign-in (within 15 minutes), else MainTabs. A new account continues: About (customer or merchant form) → Password → ConfirmPassword → Location (map + sheet, or Skip for now) → account created → goAfterSignIn. Progress bar: 0 / 20 / 30 / 50 / 50 / 85%. OAuth skips every sign-up step. Signed-out gates in tabs use the shared sign-in panel. Product, booking and search gates navigate to Welcome. Logout and delete account reset to Welcome. A server-forced sign-out shows a toast and resets to Welcome.

ENTRY POINTS: push router (push-routes.ts) for customer booking, deposit, claim and KYC types, plus owner ring, booking, handover, return, claim, shop_closed, bank, product_checked and merchant_approval. Custom-scheme deep links: shop/product (QR/WhatsApp attribution), pay/return, kyc/return. Play-referrer install attribution on Android.

GLOBAL OVERLAYS: a custom toast above the tab bar; one app-wide error boundary ('Something went wrong on this screen' / 'Try again'); system push banners in the foreground; ShopRing full-screen takeover for owners. NOT present: no app-update / force-update prompt, no offline banner or NetInfo, no in-app push pre-permission screen. NetworkDiagnostics exists but has no entry point.

DEAD / HALF-BUILT:
- ProfileStackScreen and HomeStack are never mounted.
- A duplicate root 'profile' route exists.
- CurrencySheet is mounted but nothing opens it.
- isReportModalVisible / showReportModal in global context has no consumer.
- errors.sameName on About is never set.
- OAuth errors are swallowed silently.
- No forgot-password flow.
- Phone input is raw E.164 with no country picker.
- Resend OTP has no cooldown.
- Welcome slide 3 and the sign-in panel still advertise chat / messaging owners.
- Profile 'Today and bookings' shows for plain customers too.
openQuestions: How does a Google/Apple (OAuth) sign-up become a merchant, or give DOB or location? OAuth skips About, Password and Location, and no screen in the app changes account_type later.
Should Profile > 'Today and bookings' (ShopToday) show for pure customers who have never listed? Today it shows for every signed-in user, merchants included, who already have it in the Rentals tab.
Chat is off (T-01), but Welcome slide 3 ('The chat feature lets you talk to the owner…') and the sign-in panel ('message owners') still promise it. Should the redesign rewrite that copy?

The push-notification permission prompt only fires because the disabled chat subscription calls registerForPushNotificationsAsync on first MainTabs render. Should the new design add a deliberate pre-permission moment (e.g. on first booking or first listing)?
Should there be a forgot-password flow? 'Use my password' exists but there is no reset path.
Do we want https universal / app links? Only renit:// and renit-qa:// custom schemes are configured; QR and WhatsApp shop links rely on them plus the Play referrer.
Should the phone screen get a country picker (default +91) instead of raw E.164 input?

areas.flowsSummary:
Entry: signed-in users, or anyone who has seen Welcome, land on MainTabs > Home. Tabs are Home · Saved · Post · Rentals · Profile. Chat is switched off (CHAT_ENABLED=false in src/lib/config.ts:271) and Rentals took its slot. Home is identical for guest, customer and merchant. The only role difference near discovery is that a merchant's Rentals tab opens their shop.

Browse path: on Home, a category tile opens CategoryLanding (sub-category tiles plus 'Near you' grid). A sub-category tile, or any of the Filters/Sort/Dates pills, pushes SearchResults scoped to that category. On SearchResults the '{Parent} ›' crumb returns to the landing, and rail pills re-scope in place. 'All categories' leads to AllCategories, which leads on to CategoryLanding.

Search path: Home's search field opens Search (What? with suggestions, Where? sheet, When? date picker). 'Search' or 'Browse all' opens SearchResults. Tapping the results' summary bar replaces it with a prefilled Search.

Refine: SearchResults has the FilterBar (Filters/Sort/Dates/'Delivers to me' plus quick spec chips) and a tabbed Filters sheet (Sort, Category, Specs, Price, Ratings, Condition, Seller) with a live 'Show N results'. A delivery address row opens the saved-address picker, or asks to sign in or add an address. Empty results offer 'Clear filters' and a 'Request an item' card.

Every product tile in Home, Landing, Results, Saved, the owner profile and OwnersProducts opens ProductDetail. The heart saves the listing, or shows a sign-in toast for guests. ProductDetail's owner row opens UserDetail ('About the owner'); 'View all products' leads to OwnersProducts (with Share) and 'View all reviews' to OwnersReviewScreen. UserDetail can also be opened by renit://shop/{id} deep links from the public shop page, and by a merchant's own KycStatus CTA. ProductDetail's sub-category breadcrumb pushes SearchResults.

Saved: a signed-in grid of favourites, or a guest sign-in panel. Home's 'Request an item' card goes to the unavailabilityFormCategories flow (Choose a category, then sub-category, then a form with product name, quantity, dates, location, address, contact method and 'Submit'), which lives in a separate area.

Not present in the current app: banners or promos on Home, recent searches, a map view, saved searches, and wishlist collections.
openQuestions: Should the redesign keep the three Home rails ('Top experiences', 'Top picks to explore', 'Popular near you')? Client-side dedupe makes them disappear when the catalogue is small, and rails with no items hide silently.
The brief mentions Home banners, but the current code has none. Are banners a new requirement, or should they be left out?

Home sends signed-out users straight into the 'Request an item' form, while the guest Profile row sends them to Welcome first. Which behaviour is intended, and does submitting the form need an account?

On CategoryLanding the Sort and Dates pills only open the results without opening the sort sheet or picker. Should they open the sheet or picker directly, or be redesigned as a single 'See all' action?
The guest sign-in copy on Saved ('Sign in to save listings, message owners and track your rentals.') mentions messaging while chat is off. Should the copy change?
Saved's 'Browse listings' probably does nothing (navigate('MainTabs') with no screen). Should it go to Home?
Should the owner profile get a real error and retry state, show 'Verified' chips on its listing cards, and offer Share on the profile itself rather than only on 'Listings'?
OwnersProducts shows every heart as unsaved and stretches a lone last card to full width. Should it use the same tile grid as Results and Saved?
RatingFilter bug: the Product Review stars write the owner rating. Fix it, or redesign the Ratings tab (it is visually older than Sort, Seller and Specs)?
Search 'Where' sheet: the 'nearby places' list shows restaurants (Google type=restaurant). Keep a nearby list, or replace it with saved addresses or recent places?
When location is refused, discovery silently falls back to lat 19, long 72 with no UI. Should Home show a location chip or prompt?

areas.flowsSummary: Main path (signed in): ProductDetail → [Book now / Book for the morning] → BookingDates (calendar + 'How will you get it?': Self pickup · Free vs Delivery to {address} · ₹fee · km, address via 'Delivery address' sheet → LocationModal → AddressDetails) → Continue → ReviewAndBook (server quote: rent, delivery, Renit's fee, total; 'What you pay, and when': Now ₹99 / After the owner accepts / Deposit; plain cancellation lines; ID check card if the item needs one → KycIntro → KycDetails → DigiLocker (external) → KycStatus → back; Bill to GSTIN for business customers; rental terms tick) → 'Book now · Pay ₹99' → stack reset to Rentals › [Cart] › Booking(pay) → external pay page (Linking.openURL) → Booking view Confirming ('Asking {Shop}': Ringing → Calling the owner; or closed shop 'Asked at 9:00 am tomorrow') → accepted: Pay rent ('{Shop} accepted', countdown, 'Pay ₹X') → external pay page → BookingWindow (pick a 1-hour window) → Booking details 'Booking confirmed' → Deposit (BookingDeposit) if not paid with rent. Refused or no answer: Outcome ('Your request') with other dates / other owners, the ₹99 moving (moved_from), or 'No thanks, refund my ₹99'. Cart path: ProductDetail 'Add to cart' (only when can_add_to_cart) → Cart (one card per shop) → Check out → BookingDates card mode (leave in cart / add back, up to 6 items) → ReviewAndBook card mode → same Booking views (partial accept possible). Signed out: Book now / Add to cart → toast → Welcome, return-to brings the user back (Add to cart completes itself). Chat with owner and offers are switched off (CHAT_ENABLED=false); the PDP bar is Book now / Add to cart only.

areas.flowsSummary: Customer journey after Book now, all on one keyed `Booking {number}` route whose body is picked by server stage (src/lib/booking.ts bookingView): pay ₹99 → confirming (owner rung) → outcome (refused / no answer / owner cancelled; alternative dates or owners, ₹99 moves or refunds) or pay rent (countdown) → confirmed (booking-details-view: pick arrival window → pay deposit, 24 h before / due 2 h before) → ready = day-of. The day-of splits two ways. (a) In person (pickup or shop delivery): Maps, preset status taps (On my way / Running late / I am here), Call the shop, ID note, basket item ticks with a Not-here sheet, Capture (photos + video + included items), Check both sets, show the 6-digit handover code that the shop types. Escape hatches: 'The shop isn't here?' (no-show report) and 'Not as described?' (refuse at door). (b) Renit courier partner (Borzo, never named): server tracker steps + desk banner, Track rider (external https link) / Call rider / Call via Renit, then 'Open it on camera' within 30 min of delivery, which starts the rental, plus 'Problem at the door?'. Then out = rental-active: return-by and late-day cost, deposit held, Extend (stepper → ReviewAndBook with extends → a new booking the shop must accept), 'Something doesn't work?' fault report within 24 h → Claim, monthly schedule / Rent due / End early sheet (monthly only), Booking details, Get help. Return: record again → the shop records → type the shop's 6-digit return code (in person); or courier: pick return window → seal bag → rider. Then returned (banner + timeline row say what deposit comes back within 48 h, minus late days / notice / agreed damage) → closed ('Rental complete' + 'Review your rental' → WriteReviews). Deposit refund, rental end and tracking have no dedicated screens: they are banner subs, timeline rows and Payments refund rows. Cancel is a sheet that quotes the money first. Every screen has Get help (a note to the desk, who phone back; 'There is no chat'). Pushes route to Booking / BookingDeposit / Claim. The in-app Notifications list (Profile bell) holds the same push bodies but isn't tappable.
openQuestions: Chat is off (CHAT_ENABLED=false, src/lib/config.ts). The Rentals tab took its slot, and Get help says 'There is no chat: the desk answers by phone.' A redesign must not show chat with the shop on a booking.

Notifications list: rows render notification.user (the recipient), so booking notifications show the customer's own avatar and name. Rows are not tappable and opening marks all as read. Should the redesign show title + booking link? That needs an API change: the Notification row has no booking FK or title.

'End the rental early' renders on can('end_early'), but the sheet only mounts for monthly bookings (rental-active.tsx). Confirm the server only offers end_early on monthly billing, otherwise this is a dead tap.
Reviews: the booking's 'Write a review' has no 'already reviewed' state and passes no owner/price. Does the server expose a reviewed flag, so the prompt can turn into 'Reviewed'?
The WriteReviews frame omits the owner review and both star ratings that the API requires. Which is right, the design or the API? (product decision, noted in design/audit.md)
There is no in-app live map for courier tracking: 'Track rider' opens the courier's https page externally. Is an embedded map wanted, or should designs keep the step list + external link?

There is no dedicated deposit-refund or rental-closed screen. Refund status appears only as Payments rows ('On its way' / 'Sent' / 'Failed · Renit is on it') and banner copy. Should a designer add a receipt/summary screen, or keep it inline?
No order search/filter; Rentals has only Active/Past. Fine for launch?

Monthly billing (ENG-282: schedule, Rent due, notice, end early) and baskets (multi-item bookings with per-item ticks, partial accept, left-out items) are live code paths, but QA coverage is unknown. Should designers draw both variants for every booking screen?
Pre-accept views (pay ₹99, confirming, outcome, pay rent) and the Capture walkthrough were only skimmed here; they probably belong to the checkout and handover-capture inventories.

areas.flowsSummary:
How audience is used here: 'shop' means any signed-in account that has listed something. That includes individual owners (account_type 'user'), not only merchants. Merchant-only differences:
- the approval gate on the Post tab and listing flow (pending/rejected card, 'Request review again')
- the Rentals tab becomes the shop console, with a 'My rentals' segment
- the business KYC card, KYC nudge and KYC screens
- the Shop address row, which is required to publish
- dashboard notes in Settings and Delivery
- 'Business billing' hidden in Profile

Onboarding: About ('Are you a merchant?' + business name + owner terms) → pending approval (Post tab gate). The admin approves on the server, and a 'Profile' push refreshes the status. Optional KYC: KycIntro → KycDetails → DigiLocker → KycStatus.

Listing: Post tab → ListAddPhotos (photos upload at once; owner terms tick) → ListReading (AI streams fields, with retake warnings) → ListReview (price plans, condition, category and specs, title/brand/model/description, pickup, worth, stock, not-delivered, deposit) → ListPreview ('Submit for review'; can fail with publish_locked) → ListSubmitted (Checking/Live/Flagged). 'I'll fill it in myself' skips the AI.

Manage: Profile → My Products (status pills, prompts) → Edit product (Category, Product Details, Product Images and cover, Unavailability, Archive).

Orders: a request rings full screen (ShopRing: Accept, Accept K of N, Can't do it with block dates). Then ShopBooking runs Accepted → Confirmed (the customer pays and picks a window) → Ready → ShopHandover (status buttons, Call via Renit, condition capture by both sides, type the customer's code → 'Start the rental'; no-show report). Courier bookings instead get Pack, seal number, Packed, rider OTP and 'Handed to rider'. Out → ShopReturn (record again, 'All good · show my code' or Report a problem → Claim). Today gathers ringing, going out, coming back, Needs you, quick walk-in blocks and the Open switch.

Settings: Profile → Rental settings (Open, hours, closed-until, notice, delivery and areas, GST, shop address, devices). Bank account is a prerequisite for Accept.

What the app does not have:
- chat: it is off app-wide, and the shop side uses preset status buttons, Call via Renit and the Get help desk note ('There is no chat')
- an earnings or payouts screen
- pause, unpause or publish-draft for listings (dashboard only; the app only photographs drafts)
- specs in the edit form
- a way for the shop to end a rental early (it goes through the desk)

Half-built:
- the My Products empty-state CTA goes to MainTabs
- the 'Load More' text is not tappable
- the edit screens still use the old wizard forms and title-case headers
- Profile's shop rows show to pure customers
openQuestions: Payout copy conflicts. The KYC intro says verification 'will be needed for payouts when they launch', but Bank account and the booking Money card say rent is paid to the bank on the day of handover. Which is true for the design?
Should Profile's shop rows ('Today and bookings', 'My products', 'Rental settings', 'Bank account') stay visible to customers who have never listed? Today each screen shows its own empty state.
Pause/unpause, publishing drafts, bulk import and some delivery settings are on the web dashboard only. Should the redesign bring any of these into the app?
Should the edit-product screens be redesigned to match the AI listing flow's Review form (plans, specs, AI marks), or stay as the old wizard forms?
There is no earnings or payout-history screen. Is one wanted, or do the per-booking Money card and Bank account cover it?
Does the merchant approval state (pending/rejected) need its own designed screen, or are the Post tab card and Profile card enough?
Copy for LocationModal and AddressPickerSheet was not re-verified in this pass, because they are shared with the customer side.

Profile tab. Personal details sheet: Profile picture (Upload -> gallery/camera sheet -> 'Update Profile Picture'); Full name (locked note while verified or in review); Email and Phone (first a code to the current number through the reused bank UnlockSheet, then a code to the new value: 'Verify' -> OTP -> 'Done'); Password ('Verify & Change', a stub with no API); 'Delete my account' -> modal (Cancel/Delete, or 'Your account can't be closed yet' listing open bookings, deposits, refunds, payouts and reports from the server).

Trust/KYC is not documents or selfies. It is PAN (+ GST yes/no + GSTIN + optional Udyam/shop licence for merchants) then the Cashfree DigiLocker Aadhaar hand-off in a secure browser, then automated checks, then a human review, then a push. Merchants get 'Business verification' (Verified business badge); everyone else gets an 'ID check', started from the price screen (ReviewAndBook) for higher-value items, and the Profile card appears only once a check is on file. Flow: KycIntro (what you need, how it works, full consent text, checkbox, Continue) -> KycDetails ('Continue to DigiLocker') -> DigiLocker -> KycStatus (polls 30 s; states none / pending / action_required / in_review / verified / rejected with 9 reasons / timed out / badge removed; CTAs Continue verification, Start over, Try again, Contact support, See my public profile, Back to your booking, Remove my verification data). A one-time KycNudge sits on ListSubmitted for merchants. Merchant admin approval (gates listing) is separate from KYC.

Saved addresses: list (max 20, Default tag) -> 'Add new address' -> LocationModal map -> Address details (map preview + Change, flat/building, landmark, PIN code, Save as Home/Work/Other, name, default checkbox, Save) / edit -> Save changes or Delete address (confirm sheet).

Support: FAQs (static accordion), Report a problem and Feedback & Review (text box -> toast -> back), Contact Us (mailto, tel, feedback), Who we are (-> FAQs). Terms opens the server's terms URL in the browser with a bundled fallback; Privacy is bundled.

Request an item: from the Profile row, the Home card and the SearchResults empty card -> category -> sub-category -> form (name, quantity, dates, location via LocationModal, address, contact mode + value) -> Submit -> toast -> root 'profile' (no tab bar).

Unreachable or dead: Currency sheet, NetworkDiagnostics, legacy unavailabilityForm, nested ProfileStackScreen. Chat is off (CHAT_ENABLED=false), so no Chat tab and no in-app support chat.

critic.flowsSummary: The independent sweep of nav.tsx, src/screens and src/components agrees with the combined inventory on every registered route except one. BusinessBilling (ENG-352) is registered at nav.tsx:1048, reached from the Profile row for non-merchants and from ReviewAndBook's 'Add your GSTIN' link, and is missing from every area. Chat is confirmed off: CHAT_ENABLED=false at config.ts:271, which drops the Chat tab and both 'Chat with owner' buttons; ChatDetails can still open from a legacy chat push. Profile's shop rows (Today and bookings, My products, Rental settings, Bank account) show for every signed-in user with no role gate. The other gaps are sheets, alerts and inline states the readers only named generically or missed: the bank unlock-code sheet and add-phone alert, the rental-hours time sheet, the device sign-out alert, the publish-locked alert (owner terms / shop approval / shop address / ID check / bank account), the shop ring-permission card, the customer push notice, the camera-off notice, the report/claim/discard confirm sheets, and the photo long-press actions. The in-app notifications list cannot be tapped and its empty copy still mentions chat 'Replies'. A forced sign-out sends the user to Welcome with no message. Dead code: ProfileStackScreen is never mounted, AddressChoiceModal is imported but unused, CurrencySheet and the unavailabilityForm and NetworkDiagnostics routes are unreachable, and core SplashScreen is unused.
